claim: Explicit relationships among changes, models, obligations, and evidence guide validation effort; incomplete relationships can require broader checks.
topology: Three horizontal bands group models, obligations, and evidence; single central arrows connect proposed change, bands, and admission.
bw_encoding: Light gray identifies the three grouped bands.
redesign: Replaced the two-boundary timeline with author-supplied model-aware change-impact structure. Worker concurrency connects related execution, memory, and latency models to potentially affected obligations and required evidence. Three shaded horizontal bands group models, obligations, and evidence. Single vertical arrows connect the bands on one spine; no individual split rails or legend. The later validation-bottleneck episode is retained.
alt: A proposed increase in worker concurrency leads through execution, memory, and latency models to legal ordering, peak-memory, and latency obligations. Correctness tests, memory analysis or measurement, and performance tests supply evidence for admission. Models, obligations, and evidence form three shaded bands connected by single downward arrows on a central spine.
